title: fix(cloud-connection, driver-sql): a package upgrade relaxes the NOT NULL its own declaration makes nullable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLNSrSXhrfoTmkZXX7YyRjW)_

Part of #33724 — this PR closes the platform half: the install door relaxes the column, the driver door it asks, and the remedy text. The hosted half stays open on the card: a hosted install through `os package publish --install` runs in the control plane's own install door, which is not in this repository; whether that door calls the exported `relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull` after its schema sync is the cloud lane's question.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new root exports of @objectstack/cloud-connection (relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull, declaredNullableColumns, types InstallRelaxDriver/InstallRelaxEngine/InstallRelaxEntry/InstallRelaxReport) and the public method SqlDriver.relaxDeclaredNotNull
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：包升级把字段改成 `storage: { notNull: false }` 后，install-local 安装门在 managed 安装/升级的 schema sync 之后，把该包自己声明可空的列的 NOT NULL 放开；`[schema-drift]` 警告与 `migrate plan` 的补救文案按对象种类分别说明（环境内创作的对象走发布，包对象走安装/升级包）。
- **为什么改**：包对象是密封的，发布门答 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`，启动又从不改列，所以升级后每条不填该字段的写入都被数据库拒绝，只能本地 `os migrate apply`；托管租户无路可走（blackcat CRM 的产品价格即此例）。
- **风险与回滚**：只做放开 NOT NULL 一种变更，且只针对安装中的包自己的声明（他包、定制、未声明的 NOT NULL、其它漂移种类一概不动），不会丢数据；回滚即 revert 本 PR，已放开的列保持可空、无害。
- **先看**：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-declared-relaxations.ts`（只认本包声明的规则）、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` 的 `relaxDeclaredNotNull`（只选 relax 条目）、`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 第 4b″ 步（只在热加载成功后调用，不在启动/rehydrate 调用）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-declared-relax.test.ts`，预期 7 个用例全绿：v1 NOT NULL → v2 可空的升级后列变为可空、缺该字段的创建成功；热注册宽松失败（无 4xx）时列保持 NOT NULL。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地；托管控制面的安装门是否调用导出的 helper 由 cloud 车道回答。

## What changes

- **`SqlDriver.relaxDeclaredNotNull(obj, columns, opts?)`** (`packages/drivers/driver-sql`). Applies the one `needs_confirm` entry the publish door also applies for a declaration in words — `relax_not_null` on a NOT NULL column whose served field declares `storage: { notNull: false }` — and only on a column the caller names. No `safe` entry, no undeclared NOT NULL, no index, nothing `destructive`. It reads neither `autoMigrate` nor `NODE_ENV` and no boot calls it (ADR-0113 D5; `schema-drift.ts`'s ⛔ note on the relax entry: a boot never applies it, a deliberate act does).
- **Install door step 4b″** (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). After a managed install or upgrade's schema sync, and only when the running kernel serves the new version (not on the lenient path, whose restart rehydrate is a boot), the door asks the driver to relax the columns the installing package's own body declares nullable. Applied relaxes are logged by the driver; an object whose driver has no relax door, a skipped entry or a failure is logged at `warn` with the remedy. The install's answer is unchanged.
- **`relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull` / `declaredNullableColumns`** (new `marketplace-install-declared-relaxations.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/cloud-connection`). The rule, reusable by a host's own install door: the package's own objects and the fields its `objectExtensions` contribute (the declared-rename planner's `contributionsOf`, now exported from its module), federated objects skipped, the engine and driver read structurally as the rename carry reads them.
- **Remedy text** (`schema-drift.ts`). The relax entry's message named "publishing the object" alone, which a sealed package object refuses. It now names publish for an object authored in the environment, a managed install or upgrade of its package for a package object, and `os migrate apply` for either.
- **Turso REMOTE face** (`turso-driver.ts`, seat-approved). One `REMOTE_FACE_ANSWERS` row, `relaxDeclaredNotNull: 'inherited'`: the relax needs the SQLite table rebuild that transport does not run, so it comes back skipped with the face's reason.

## Tests

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-install-declared-relax.test.ts` — every dialect cell: only the named, declared column is relaxed; a create without it then succeeds; an undeclared NOT NULL and an unnamed declared-nullable column stay; the `safe` date → datetime widening is not applied (off SQLite); idempotent; empty column list is a no-op; the per-kind remedy text.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-declared-relax.test.ts` — the door over a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite): v1 → v2 upgrade relaxes and the create succeeds; undeclared NOT NULL stays; an extension field is relaxed; an unrelated package's install leaves another package's column; the lenient path (a cloud upgrade whose register throws with no 4xx, after writing the new declaration) leaves the column NOT NULL and answers `hotLoaded: false`; a driver without the door installs as before and is logged at `warn`; `declaredNullableColumns` reads only the body's own words.
- `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-remote-migration-entries.test.ts` — one top-level `describe`: on the remote face the relax is skipped with the face's reason and the column stays NOT NULL.

## Acceptance notes

- The hosted path is not closed here. `os package publish --install` installs through the control plane, whose install door is in the cloud repository; this PR exports the step so that door can call it. Reported on the card as `carrier: cloud`.
- ADR-0113 D5 (as amended on `main` today) names the publish as the deliberate relax of an explicit `storage: { notNull: false }`. This PR adds the managed package install as the same deliberate act for a sealed package object; it auto-applies nothing and the boot still applies nothing, so it reverses no line of D5. A one-line D5 amendment naming the install is `docs/adr/**` (Tier H) and is left to the seat as a follow-up, not edited here.
- The `safe` widening entries (`widen_date_to_datetime`, `widen_varchar`, `drop_column_default`) on a sealed package object have the same "publishing the object applies it" sentence and the same missing door; the card asked for NOT NULL only, so they are listed as a loose end in the report, not changed here.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1 driver door ignores the named-column set: 3 of 11 red (the unnamed declared-nullable column relaxed).
- A2 driver door ignores the explicit `notNull: false`: 3 of 11 red (the undeclared NOT NULL relaxed).
- A3 the install door never calls the step: 2 of 6 red (on `d248309b`) (upgrade and extension cases keep NOT NULL).
- A4 the remedy text loses the package-object clause: 1 of 11 red.
- A5 `declaredNullableColumns` takes every field: 1 of 6 red.
- A7 the step-4b″ guard `if (hotLoadError === undefined)` replaced by `if (true)`: 1 of 7 red, the lenient-path case (`AssertionError: expected true to be false`, the column relaxed), green after restore.
- A8 the `unsupported` warn loop iterates nothing: 1 of 7 red, the no-door case, green after restore.
- A6 the driver door selects nothing, through the built `driver-sql` dist (`ablation-dist-preflight`: marker in 2 dist files, absent from all 6 after restore and rebuild): the turso remote pin red, green after restore.

</details>
